# CF0 Homelab — Project Index & Analysis

## Overview

A **multi-stack AI/ML homelab** on a single workstation (i9-9900K, 107GB RAM, GTX 1060 6GB), deployed via **Ansible IaC** + **Docker Compose**. The project manages ~25 containerized services across 6 compose stacks focused on local LLM inference, RAG pipelines, AI tooling, finance, and monitoring.

---

## Architecture — 6 Compose Stacks

| Stack | File | Project | Services |
|-------|------|---------|----------|
| **Core LLM** | docker-compose.yml | `cf-core` | Ollama (GPU), Open WebUI, SearXNG, MindsDB, Cognee, ZeroClaw, RedisInsight |
| **OpenRAG** | docker-compose.openrag.yml | `cf-openrag` | OpenSearch, Dashboards, Langflow, OpenRAG backend/frontend |
| **Expand** | docker-compose.expand.yml | `cf-expand` | n8n, Nuclio, Qdrant, Redis, PostgreSQL, TensorLake, Nautilus, OpenBB |
| **Scrutiny** | docker-compose.scrutiny.yml | `cf-scrutiny` | Scrutiny (SMART disk monitoring, 7 disks) |
| **OpenSpace** | docker-compose.openspace.yml | `cf-openspace` | Skill evolution dashboard (custom build) |
| **Serena** | docker-compose.serena.yml | `cf-serena` | MCP server for codebase-aware coding (localhost only) |

## Port Map (25 services)

| Port | Service | Port | Service |
|------|---------|------|---------|
| 3000 | OpenRAG Frontend | 8070 | Nuclio |
| 4433 | PostgreSQL | 8080 | Open WebUI |
| 5540 | RedisInsight | 8081 | SearXNG |
| 5601 | OpenSearch Dashboards | 8889 | Nautilus (JupyterLab) |
| 5679 | n8n | 8900 | TensorLake |
| 6333/6334 | Qdrant (REST/gRPC) | 9121 | Serena MCP |
| 6900 | OpenBB | 9200/9600 | OpenSearch |
| 7786 | Scrutiny | 11434 | Ollama |
| 7788 | OpenSpace | 42617 | ZeroClaw |
| 7860 | Langflow | 47334/47335 | MindsDB (HTTP/MySQL) |
| 8000 | Cognee | | |

## Ansible — 9 Playbooks, 9 Roles

**Playbooks** in playbooks:
- **setup.yml** — Full deployment (all roles, pre-flight checks)
- **llm-stack.yml** — Core LLM services + bandwidth limiting
- **llm-tools.yml** — Install 12 CLI/local tools (Node.js, Rust, ZeroClaw, Claude Code, uv, etc.)
- **openrag-stack.yml** / **expand-stack.yml** / **monitoring.yml** / **openspace.yml** / **serena.yml** — Individual stack deployments
- **deploy.yml** — Generic compose lifecycle (up/down/restart)
- **ddns.yml** — Cloudflare DDNS update

**Roles** in roles: `ollama`, `open-webui`, `searxng`, `mindsdb`, `cognee`, `zeroclaw`, `openrag`, `scrutiny`, `openspace` — each with defaults, templates, handlers, and health checks.

## Service Dependency Graph

```
Ollama (GPU) ──→ Open WebUI (chat UI)
     │          ├→ ZeroClaw (CLI assistant)
     │          └→ OpenRAG Backend → Langflow → OpenSearch
     │
     ├→ Cognee (knowledge graph) → RedisInsight
     └→ MindsDB (AI analytics)

PostgreSQL ──→ n8n (workflows)
Redis ──→ Cognee, future: mem0/firecrawl
Qdrant ──→ Vector search (for RAG, embeddings)
```

## Key Observations

1. **Ollama is the backbone** — nearly every AI service depends on it for inference (qwen3.5:9b default model).
2. **Well-structured IaC** — every service has an Ansible role with defaults, templates, health checks, and a corresponding compose file.
3. **Resource-conscious** — CPU/memory limits on secondary services (Cognee 8GB, Scrutiny 400M, OpenSpace 500M), Ollama runs uncapped.
4. **Feature-toggled** — 12+ tools controlled via `enable_*` flags in group_vars/all.yml and shell env vars.
5. **Model sync is configurable** — ollama-models.env controls which models to pull (only qwen3.5:9b enabled by default, 20+ available).
6. **Security**: All services localhost-bound or on Docker bridges. Serena locked to `127.0.0.1`. No external exposure. Credentials in `.env` files (OpenSearch, Langflow, PostgreSQL).
7. **Vendor code**: serena is a vendored copy of the [Serena MCP toolkit](https://github.com/oraios/serena) (40+ language LSP-based code tools). unsloth_compiled_cache contains pre-compiled Unsloth trainer classes for LLM fine-tuning.
8. **Expand stack partially disabled** — mcaptcha, mem0-server, kokoro-fastapi, firecrawl, gitingest, docetl are commented out (require manual builds).
9. **Single-node design** — everything targets `cf0`. No clustering, no HA. RAID0 on home (speed over redundancy).

### Issues Fixed

| # | Severity | Fix | Files Modified |
|---|----------|-----|----------------|
| 1 | **CRITICAL** | `community.general.tc` module doesn't exist — replaced with `shell` + `tc qdisc` | llm-stack.yml |
| 2 | **CRITICAL** | Template `expand.env.j2` doesn't exist — replaced with inline `copy` | expand-stack.yml |
| 3 | **CRITICAL** | `docker_prune_images`/`docker_prune_volumes` undefined — added defaults | deploy.yml |
| 4 | **HIGH** | `open-webui-data: external: true` breaks standalone deploy — removed `external` | docker-compose.yml |
| 5 | **HIGH** | Moved volume creation out of ollama role (no longer needed) | ollama/tasks/main.yml |
| 6 | **HIGH** | `container_name: cf0-serena` inconsistent — changed to `serena` | docker-compose.serena.yml |
| 7 | **HIGH** | ZeroClaw role only installed binary, never deployed Docker service — now deploys containers (zeroclaw + redisinsight) | zeroclaw/tasks/main.yml |
| 8 | **MEDIUM** | Cognee missing from llm-stack health checks — added | llm-stack.yml |
| 9 | **LOW** | Deprecated docker-compose.monitoring.yml with port conflicts — deleted | (deleted) |

### Naming Convention Verified

All 6 compose stacks use `cf-*` project names, and all 25+ services have explicit `container_name` set to their bare service name:

| Stack | Project Name | Containers |
|-------|-------------|------------|
| Core | `cf-core` | `ollama`, `open-webui`, `searxng`, `mindsdb`, `zeroclaw`, `cognee`, `redisinsight` |
| OpenRAG | `cf-openrag` | `opensearch`, `opensearch-dashboards`, `langflow`, `openrag-backend`, `openrag-frontend` |
| Expand | `cf-expand` | `n8n`, `qdrant`, `redis-tools`, `postgres-tools`, `nuclio-dashboard`, `tensorlake`, `nautilus-trader`, `openbb` |
| Scrutiny | `cf-scrutiny` | `scrutiny` |
| OpenSpace | `cf-openspace` | `openspace` |
| Serena | `cf-serena` | `serena` (was `cf0-serena`) |

`docker exec ollama` / `docker exec searxng` / etc. will work correctly since every service has `container_name` set.

### Remaining Notes

- The `llm-tools.yml` playbook installs ZeroClaw as a binary (CLI tool). The `zeroclaw` role now deploys the Docker container. Both paths are valid — the binary gives CLI access while the container provides the gateway API at port 42617.
- The `open-webui-data` volume is now a regular Docker-managed volume. If there's an existing `external: true` volume on cf0, compose will create a new one. Run `docker volume ls | grep open-webui` on cf0 to check.

Ran terminal command:  ssh r@cf0 'echo "=== Volume migration: compose_* -> clean names ===" && \
migrate_vol() {
  local old="$1" new="$2"
  if docker volume inspect "$old" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if docker volume inspect "$new" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "SKIP $old -> $new (target exists)"
    else
      docker volume create "$new" >/dev/null && \
      docker run --rm -v "$old":/from -v "$new":/to alpine sh -c "cp -a /from/. /to/" && \
      echo "OK   $old -> $new" || echo "FAIL $old -> $new"
    fi
  else
    echo "SKIP $old (source not found)"
  fi
}

- `make setup` — full stack | `make llm` — LLM core | `make openrag` — RAG pipeline | etc.

**Modifiers (combinable):**
- `CHECK=1` — dry run | `VERBOSE=1` — verbose | `TAGS=ollama` — specific role | `DIFF=1` — show file diffs

**Lifecycle:**
- `make pull` — pull all images | `make down` — stop core | `make down-all` — stop everything (with confirmation)

**Operations:**
- `make status` — containers on cf0 | `make health` — probe all endpoints | `make logs SVC=ollama` — tail logs | `make restart-svc SVC=open-webui`

**Validation:**
- `make syntax` — syntax-check all playbooks | `make lint` — ansible-lint | `make ping` — test connectivity

### Port Conflict Resolution
| Service | Original | Resolved | Reason |
|---------|----------|----------|--------|
| Flowise | 3000 | **7861** | Conflicts with OpenRAG frontend |
| Unsloth | 8000+8888 | **8888 only** | 8000 conflicts with Cognee |
| Onyx | 3100 | 3100 | No conflict |

### Non-Docker Exceptions (by design)

These components **cannot** run in Docker and are installed natively:

| Component | Why Not Docker | Install Method |
|-----------|---------------|----------------|
| **Node.js** | Host dependency for npm global tools | APT via NodeSource |
| **Rust** | Host dependency for cargo builds | rustup |
| **Claude Code** | CLI tool, no server process | `npm -g` |
| **MetaClaw** | CLI tool, no server process | `pip` |
| **uv** | Standalone binary, Python package manager | curl installer |
| **Gstack** | CLI tool, no server process | `npm -g` |
| **ZeroClaw binary** | Standalone binary (5MB) | GitHub release tarball |
| **sysctl/ulimits** | Kernel-level tuning | sysctl.d, limits.d |
| **UFW firewall** | Kernel-level netfilter | `community.general.ufw` |
| **NVIDIA driver/toolkit** | Must be on host for GPU passthrough | APT + nvidia-ctk |
| **Bandwidth shaping** | `tc` operates on host NIC | `tc qdisc` via rc.local |
| **docling-serve** | Systemd service (could be Dockerized, but source script uses pip+systemd) | pip + systemd unit |

### Makefile Targets (new)
```
make bootstrap    # Host bootstrap (APT, Docker, NVIDIA, sysctl, UFW)
make ai-apps      # Optional AI apps (Flowise, Unsloth, Onyx)
make llm-tools    # CLI tools (Claude Code, MetaClaw, uv, ZeroClaw, docling-serve)
```

Let me check what we currently do for language version management across the codebase: 

Searched for regex `nvm|nodesource|node.*version|rustup|pyenv|miniforge|conda|fnm` (`**/ansible/**/*.yml`), 20 results

Searched for regex `nodesource|setup_22|node.*apt|fnm|nvm` (`**/ansible/**/*.yml`), 7 results

Here's the current state:

| Language | Version Manager | Current Approach |
|----------|----------------|------------------|
| **Python** | **Miniforge/Conda** ✅ | Full env matrix via `host-runtimes` role — multiple Python versions (3.10, 3.11) with isolated envs per framework |
| **Rust** | **rustup** ✅ | Already using the proper version manager in llm-tools.yml |
| **Node.js** | **None** ❌ | System-wide install via NodeSource APT repo (hardcoded v22) |

**Node.js is the gap.** We're using NodeSource's `setup_22.x` script which bakes a single version system-wide — no multi-version support, and upgrading means re-running the script.

The options for Node.js version management:
- **nvm** — most popular, but shell-function-based (complicates Ansible `become_user` and non-interactive shells)
- **fnm** (Fast Node Manager) — single Rust binary, no shell-function hacks, works cleanly with Ansible

**Recommendation**: Replace NodeSource with **fnm** — it's a single binary install (`curl -fsSL https://fnm.vercel.app/install | bash`), supports `fnm install 22` / `fnm default 22`, and doesn't pollute APT sources. Want me to swap it in?
